items.description: What up Bush Fam!! I really think yall are going to like this one!! Hate sounding like a broken record but it was HOT filming this video! Glad we were able to get it done for yall! Appreciate each and everyone of yall that takes the time out to support me and the channel in the many different ways. From words of encouragement, leaving thoughtful comments or even an emoji! From the folks bringing me cold waters and drinks, to the people that watch the whole 30+ minute video or simply thinking about me and saying a prayer! I appreciate it all! Thank you!! Sorry the audio was so loud in that one spot, there was live music across the river I didn't think my mic would pick it up, but it did. Hope it doesn't take away too much from the overall video! Nevertheless, I hope you all enjoy!! Until next time.. Peace and LOVE. ______________________________ My Website: https://texasbushman.net ______________________________ Be a good person. Not necessarily a nice person, but a good person.
